comparisons.peer_summary: The Company recognizes compensation expense for stock awards over the requisite service period based on grant-date fair value, reduced by actual forfeitures. Awards for retirement-eligible employees are accrued in the year prior to the grant date, while certain performance-based or clawback provisions are subject to variable accounting that fluctuates with the stock price.
comparisons.comparison: Both Bank of America and Citigroup disclose that certain stock-based awards are subject to variable accounting, causing compensation expense to fluctuate with the stock price. BAC specifies that this applies to RSUs settled in cash or containing specific settlement provisions, whereas C states that awards with performance conditions or clawback provisions are subject to variable accounting. Both firms predominantly settle their RSUs in common stock.

sentences.text: Certain RSUs will be settled in cash or contain settlement provisions that subject these awards to variable accounting whereby compensation expense is adjusted to fair value based on changes in the share price of the Corporation's common stock up to the settlement date.

Certain stock awards with performance conditions or certain clawback provisions are subject to variable accounting, pursuant to which the associated compensation expense fluctuates with changes in Citigroup's common stock price.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm's policy is to settle employee share-based incentive awards by issuing either new shares of common stock or treasury shares, and it settled all such awards in 2024, 2023, and 2022 by issuing treasury shares.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPM disclose their settlement policies for share-based awards. BAC states RSUs settle predominantly in common stock but may settle in cash, while JPM explicitly states its policy is to issue either new shares or treasury shares and confirms it settled all employee share-based awards via treasury shares in 2024, 2023, and 2022. Neither firm mentions cash settlement for standard employee RSUs in the same manner as BAC's variable accounting discussion.

sentences.text: These RSUs were authorized to settle predominantly in shares of common stock of the Corporation.
